notes: This manifest is the canonical storage location for repo-local validation lane command sequences and their boundary roles.
docs/validation/validator_inventory.json records validation-like entrypoints and lane-backed generated checks.
scripts/validation_lanes.py is a loader/API for Python callers; do not duplicate full sequences in release_check.py, AGENTS.md, or workflow YAML.
Generated validators check projection parity only; they must not define source meaning.
Runtime, security, and eval layers are boundary-only here unless a repo-local owner surface explicitly promotes a check into release.

source_topology.title: Source/Topology Validators
source_topology.purpose: Validate authored source, route law, AGENTS mesh, package topology, owner maps, and source contracts.
checks: docs districts and root placement law
AGENTS mesh and semantic route cards
mechanic package topology and source maps
must_not: check generated freshness
perform release packaging smoke
pretend runtime policy is enforced by static docs
source_topology.route: Fix authored source or owner topology before rebuilding projections.

projection_generated.title: Projection/Generated Validators
projection_generated.purpose: Validate that generated, compact, read-model, and inventory surfaces are exact projections of source/build process.
must_not: define source meaning
replace owner docs or configs
become a hidden release validator without owner boundary
projection_generated.route: Rebuild from source, then fix the owning source or generator if parity still fails.

capability_permission.title: Capability/Permission Validators
capability_permission.purpose: Validate memo-side export, local port, and support-resource boundaries without claiming runtime tool enforcement ownership.
checks: allowed result and review route boundaries
repo-local reference safety for exported memory packets
must_not: treat prompt text as a security boundary
define MCP/tool allowlists for another runtime owner
expand privilege scope from memo docs alone
capability_permission.route: Runtime allowlists and tool scopes route to the agent/runtime owner; aoa-memo validates memo-side support contracts only.

runtime_policy.title: Runtime Policy Validators
runtime_policy.purpose: Validate repo-local memory operation modes, write-path guardrail source, and runtime-boundary declarations.
must_not: claim live approval gates or circuit breakers are enforced by CI
replace runtime policy engine checks
hide fallback-state obligations in prose only
runtime_policy.route: Live guardrails, cost caps, approvals, rollback, and circuit breakers route to the runtime policy owner.

trace_eval.title: Trace/Eval Validators
trace_eval.purpose: Validate repo-local agent-lane scenarios and regression harnesses while routing full trajectory grading to aoa-evals.
must_not: score final text only when trace behavior matters
claim environment outcome grading without an eval harness
hide grader datasets inside release orchestration
trace_eval.route: Full multi-turn trace, tool-call, environment-outcome, and grader suites route to aoa-evals.

memory_context.title: Memory/RAG/Context Validators
memory_context.purpose: Validate memory provenance, freshness, retention posture, corpus shape, poisoning boundaries, and allowed context influence.
must_not: make memory a hidden authority source
let untrusted context become instruction
collapse evidence, routing, runtime state, and memory into one proof layer
memory_context.route: Fix memo corpus, memory schema, provenance, or source contract before accepting generated context readouts.

inter_agent_handoff.title: Inter-Agent/Handoff Validators
inter_agent_handoff.purpose: Validate memo-side handoff envelopes, bridge registries, allowed delegation, and escalation boundaries.
must_not: authorize downstream agents from memo alone
erase replay/idempotency obligations
treat a bridge registry as live runtime auth
inter_agent_handoff.route: Fix mechanic-local bridge source or downstream owner contract before widening inter-agent behavior.

observability_audit.title: Observability/Audit Validators
observability_audit.purpose: Validate that memo actions leave enough public audit evidence for decisions, approvals, outputs, policy decisions, and landing logs.
checks: traceable validation receipts where memo owns them
must_not: present advisory reports as hard blockers unless promoted
confuse an audit report with source truth
hide missing trace evidence behind passing tests
observability_audit.route: Advisory audit signals stay soft unless this manifest marks the command blocking-in-release.

security_adversarial.title: Security/Adversarial Validators
security_adversarial.purpose: Validate memo-side adversarial memory boundaries such as injection-as-data, source spoofing, poisoning risk, and unsafe write handling.
must_not: treat prompt-only guardrails as a security boundary
replace red-team/eval/runtime enforcement
claim complete tool-misuse coverage from memo-local schemas
security_adversarial.route: Security findings, red-team suites, tool misuse, and runtime enforcement route to the security/eval/runtime owner surfaces.

release_operations.title: Release/Nightly/Post-Merge Validators
release_operations.purpose: Compose frozen-artifact release gates and softer drift lanes without becoming the source of individual validator meaning.
must_not: become validate_everything.py
duplicate rules owned by source/generated/runtime/eval layers
turn builders with --check into unlabeled release validators
release_operations.route: Release orchestration composes named lanes; fix the failing lane owner instead of editing release glue first.

source_fast.failure_route: Fix authored route law, owner source, package topology, or validator topology before projection checks.

generated.failure_route: Rebuild generated projections from source, then fix source or generator if parity still fails.

export_runtime.failure_route: Fix memo-side export support contracts; live tool permission enforcement routes to runtime owners.

runtime.failure_route: Fix memory operation mode source; live runtime enforcement routes to the runtime policy owner.

memory_context.failure_route: Fix memo corpus, memory schema, provenance, or source contract before widening context readouts.

inter_agent_handoff.failure_route: Fix mechanic-local bridge source or downstream owner contract before widening inter-agent handoffs.

eval.failure_route: Fix agent-lane registry, scenario, or test harness; full trajectory grading routes to aoa-evals.

audit.failure_route: Fix audit event source, landing-log projection, or explicit promotion before treating an audit as a hard gate.

security.failure_route: Fix memo-side injection/poisoning guard source; red-team and runtime enforcement route to security/eval/runtime owners.

tests.failure_route: Fix the failing test owner surface before widening release validation.

release_ops.failure_route: Fix release, nightly, or post-merge composition in validator topology before changing release glue.
